identity.baseline: monaco-editor-core@0.56.0 final snippet parser, resolver and session graph

authorities.environmentContract: E1-R owns locale-sensitive case conversion, Date, time zone, Number::toString, Math.random draw order and UUID bytes.
authorities.regexpContract: M1-R3 owns all transform regular expressions and flags.

engineSurface.representation: The Swift port keeps one mutable parse tree during construction and produces raw-UTF16 text, placeholder ranges and immutable edit inputs before the transaction gateway mutates a live model.

grammar.choices: ${1|one,two,three|} with exact comma, pipe and backslash escaping

escapes.transformRegex: An escaped slash becomes a literal slash; all other backslash sequences retain the source scanner behavior.

grammar.finalTabstop: When enforceFinalTabstop is true, or insertFinalTabstop is true and at least one placeholder exists, append placeholder 0 only when no placeholder 0 already exists.
grammar.duplicatePlaceholders: The first non-final placeholder of an index with children supplies cloned defaults to later incomplete placeholders. Nested duplicates recurse with an index stack that prevents cycles; transforms are preserved.
grammar.malformedInput: Every failed complex parse restores the scanner to the source token and the outer parser consumes literal UTF-16. Invalid transform RegExp construction returns the same fallback path and never crashes or drops the remaining template.
grammar.unknownVariables: A resolver miss leaves the Variable node unresolved; its default children render when present and it renders an empty string when it has no children.

variableSemantics.time: TimeBasedVariableResolver captures one Date at construction. Numeric fields use local Gregorian components and fixed zero padding; Unix fields use the same captured epoch; day/month names use N1 identities; offset emits signed HH:MM; time-zone name lazily caches the resolver's E1 time-zone identifier.
variableSemantics.selection: Selection and TM_SELECTED_TEXT first read the raw selected range, then the last overtyped value. Multiline content applies the exact source indentation adjustment. Current word uses the model word query. Line and cursor indices preserve their zero/one-based source definitions.
variableSemantics.clipboard: I4 supplies one pre-read raw string. In spread mode, split CRLF/LF/CR, remove falsy-or-whitespace lines, and distribute only when remaining line count equals cursor count; otherwise every cursor receives the entire string.
variableSemantics.model: Filename and path values use the pinned MonaURI, label and path contracts. TM_FILENAME_BASE removes only the final extension when its final dot index is greater than zero. No variable reads the filesystem.
variableSemantics.comments: Resolve the language ID at the selection start and return the retained language-configuration line/block comment tokens; missing configuration returns undefined and does not add a built-in language implementation.
variableSemantics.workspace: Use the S1 synthetic standalone workspace service. Empty workspaces return undefined. Workspace labels and paths remain logical URI values and perform no filesystem access.
variableSemantics.random: RANDOM, RANDOM_HEX and UUID use the E1 process-global sources, exact Number::toString suffix transform, parser traversal draw order and injected fixtures.

selectionInsert.processingOrder: Copy selections with their original index, stable-sort by Range.compareRangesUsingStarts, process in range order, then store edits and snippet sessions at the original index.
selectionInsert.timeBoundary: Each selection has a separately captured Date.
selectionInsert.cursorIdentity: CURSOR_INDEX and CURSOR_NUMBER use the original editor selection index, never the range-sorted position.

snippetEditArray.processingOrder: Copy caller edits with their original index, stable-sort by range start, parse fragments in range order into one TextmateSnippet, and emit edits with the source algorithm's range-order major identifiers.
snippetEditArray.timeBoundary: The entire edit array shares one captured Date.
snippetEditArray.cursorIdentity: CURSOR_INDEX and CURSOR_NUMBER use the caller's original edit index even though parsing runs in range order.
snippetEditArray.backfillBoundary: Before each fragment, snapshot all existing Variable nodes. Resolve only variables introduced by that fragment and clones inserted by duplicate-placeholder backfill; already resolved variables never draw or resolve again.

multiCursorAndBatchSemantics.entropyOrder: Within each processed template or fragment, depth-first parser walk order determines RANDOM, RANDOM_HEX and UUID draws; active non-snippet E1 draws remain in the same process-global sequence.

sessionContract.placeholderOrder: Numeric placeholder index order with index 0 final; equal-index occurrences mirror and select together according to the pinned OneSnippet/SnippetSession source.
sessionContract.nestedSessions: Nested snippet insertion merges or stacks exactly through the pinned session source; placeholder decorations and groups are bound to the editor, model and session generation.
sessionContract.mutation: Initial insertion, mirrored placeholder edits and final cursor placement enter the existing prepare/validate/atomic-apply transaction gateway. No parser or resolver directly mutates model truth.
sessionContract.undoRedo: The complete insertion is one editor edit operation with source identifiers and undo stops; undo/redo and external model changes update or cancel the session through the existing validity and decoration contracts.
sessionContract.microtask: The controller's deferred selection/session check uses the E1 MainActor FIFO microtask queue.
sessionContract.termination: Escape/leave, final-tabstop acceptance, incompatible cursor/model change, editor disposal or invalid generation removes all snippet decorations and context keys without retaining model ownership.

languageContentBoundary.engine: The parser, resolvers, session controller and snippet-form completion insertion are retained infrastructure.
languageContentBoundary.bundledContent: The current release ships zero built-in snippet catalog and zero code-language implementation. Direct providers and LSP completion items supply snippet text; absent support remains plain text.
languageContentBoundary.hostSurface: No new host protocol is added. Existing editor insertion APIs, direct provider values, LSP completion mapping, I4 clipboard and S1 workspace/language services are sufficient.

acceptance.C02: All transform RegExp grammar, flags, captures, replacement branches, raw-UTF16 ranges and seven format shorthands match M1/E1 fixed Chrome fixtures.
acceptance.C04: All eleven engine classes, fifteen token identities, thirty-nine variable identities, seven resolver positions and four command IDs are represented in the linked native manifest with no bundled language content.
acceptance.C05: Parser tree, rendered text, placeholder indices/ranges/order, choices, mirrors, defaults, malformed fallback, final tabstop, nested sessions, undo/redo and termination traces match.
acceptance.C06: Direct provider and LSP completion snippets preserve insert text, RegExp transforms, cancellation, model/version validity, current language comment tokens and plain-text fallback.
acceptance.C07: Placeholder focus, selected text, choice UI, command labels and announcements use native A2 controls and the same session/action identities.
acceptance.C09: Every session decoration, resolver capture and pending microtask is released on termination; 1000 lifecycle cycles and the 24-hour soak show zero retained editor/model/session graph.
acceptance.C10: Distribution scan proves zero bundled snippet catalog, zero built-in language implementation, zero JavaScript engine and exact source/data provenance.
acceptance.P08: Snippet-transform RegExp compile/execute cases remain part of the M1-R3 all-consumer find/replace workload without adding a workload ID.
acceptance.P09: Existing multicursor cells add snippet insertion, duplicate placeholders, malformed fallback, all thirty-nine variables, shared/per-cursor time boundaries, clipboard spread, original-index identity and injected random/UUID traces.
acceptance.P11: Existing provider/LSP cells add completion snippets with 1/100/10000 placeholders, cancellation, resolve and stale-result cases.
